preprocessing: renormalize each 17-domain mixture row to sum exactly 1
parameterization: ridge coefficients shifted to zero mean; intercept shifted accordingly; prediction unchanged on normalized simplex
coefficient_interpretation: relative contrast to average training-domain coefficient, not causal effect
anchor_policy: No single scalar fixed. pile_cc is a candidate anchor because its held-out cross-scale rank transfer is strongest and independently matches RegMix linear baseline; cyj must confirm Loss comparability and run sensitivity.
warning: Do not average raw 13-domain losses into one target; EXP-001 showed that aggregation destroys cross-scale signal.
